items.q: What must exist before agents extract value?
items.a: A **cohesive data strategy** out of transactional silos into recallable stores.

items.q: What else still matters besides agents?
When is waiting for the next model rational?
items.a: When today's build has **weak pressing ROI** and a better model will solve it cheaper.

items.q: What should happen to many internal apps?
items.a: Treat them as **throwaway**: POC fast, iterate, discard.

items.q: What did Norm AI build for regression?
items.a: **Tens of thousands** of expert **hand-labeled** eval samples.

items.q: What does that enable when agents arrive?
items.a: Judge model/agent changes against a **stable gold set**.
